description: After returning to Earth, Tuvok, along with the rest of the crew of Voyager, were given a hero’s welcome. Tuvok was promoted to Commander and rewarded with a comfortable posting at Starfleet Academy, utilizing his vast experience in the Delta Quadrant to raise the next generation of explorers. However, something scratched at the back of Tuvok’s mind. Sentiment and emotion were, of course, human faults but even still, he felt... he felt. This creeping growth of emotion began to disturb Tuvok. He was becoming anxious, irritable. He was having dreams, nightmares of his assimilation by the Borg. Tuvok needed clarity. He needed Vulcan. Taking a temporary leave of absence, Tuvok bid a fond farewell to his friends and crewmates and set out once more to his home world of Vulcan. There, he hoped he would once again find peace in the comforting embrace of Logic.

captain_maneuver.name: Chain of Command
captain_maneuver.bonus: This Officer does not have a Captain's Maneuver. Equipping this Officer as the captain of a ship provides no benefit.

officer_ability.name: Vulcan Security Procedures
officer_ability.bonus:
Against players with Hull Breach, Infiltrator Tuvok increases your Isolytic Cascade damage by {value} ({value} at rank {value}) for 3 rounds each time you score a hit (Once per weapon)(Cumulative).

Isolytic Cascade multiplies your total damage, including Isolytic Damage, and all research and other bonuses.

below_decks_ability.name: Logical Tactics
below_decks_ability.bonus:
On round start against players, if on a ship with no State applied Infiltrator Tuvok increases your Apex Barrier by {value} ({value} at rank {value}) for 3 rounds (Cumulative).

Apex Barrier provides <b>true damage mitigation from all sources after all other bonuses. Every 100 Apex Barrier increases the damage you can take by 1%.

This ability does not trigger when Tal is assigned to the bridge of your ship.
